records.title: Graphs, determinants of knots and hyperbolic volume
records.location: Published PDF pp431,433: Lemmas3.14,3.21; pp446-447: Proposition6.3 and Remark6.4
records.audit: Primary published statements and their elementary spanning-tree arguments read. Exact region graphs and determinant counts independently checked here. Full volume estimates and the cited Thistlethwaite arborescent classification are not audited.
records.scope: Alternating-link determinant equals checkerboard spanning-tree count; deletion-contraction. The explicit6star exception prevents inferring knot nonarborescence from failure of series-parallel diagram reduction alone. Supplies no MRC or global novelty theorem.

records.title: Meridional rank and bridge number of knotted 2-spheres
records.version_dates: arXiv2111.09233v2,6Feb2023, under the title Bridge number and meridional rank of knotted surfaces; publication metadata checked separately
records.location: Preprint Section3, especially Construction3.5, Definition3.6 and Corollary3.12
records.audit: Classical construction, periodic twist-box rules and sharpness argument read. The finite-cycle generation-capacity theorem remains an explicit source import. Entire published proof and four-dimensional/welded extensions not independently audited.
records.scope: Specified classical families K_(p,n) have mr=bridge=n via symmetric/alternating quotients with meridians p-cycles. Periodic finite-quotient twist labellings have this precedent. No proof that our four seeds belong to or lie outside these families; knotted-sphere nonadditivity is not a classical MRC counterexample.
